Name: Segub, Son of Hiel
Summary: Segub was Hiel's youngest son, in whom Hiel set up Jericho's gates, according to the word of Joshua.
KeyStory: Segub, in whom Jericho's gates were set up.
RelatedPeople: Hiel the Bethelite; Abiram, Son of Hiel
LifeLesson: The curse finished what it started, firstborn to youngest.
